decisions.reason: The author explicitly cites the September Prognos study and frames cumulative policy impacts as a scenario. Root reports that the original study physical pages 2 and 38–40 affirm the 30 percent and 1.3–1.5 ct/kWh figures, substantially rescuing the selected numerical attribution. I have not independently read the 52-page study and do not certify all assumptions. The separate assertion that new AgNes capacity charges begin on 1 January 2027 remains a definite timetable question, but should be gated by the precise regulatory stage and scenario assumptions before any allegation.
decisions.benign_alternative: The author may describe a proposed implementation scenario rather than an enacted obligation. A correct cited scenario is not a factual forecast error.

decisions.reason: The four-page context expressly offers an alternative compliance route while preserving verification and corrective duties. Root found the official ASHRAE 90.4-2022 Store description affirmatively supporting the four electrical load points and their alignment with mechanical metrics. A different edition or an unavailable paid standard cannot supply affirmative evidence of error. I agree with removal from the active queue.
decisions.primary_discovery_attribution: Root independent initial source check, relayed to this reviewer; full paid standard not read by this reviewer.

decisions.reason: The entire statement expressly concerns return of Netzreserve plants, then invokes the strategic-reserve provisions of Article 22. This creates a checkable category question, but the actual contemplated legislative mechanism is not identified. Strategic-reserve rules or state-aid conditions could apply to the concrete design. First identify the exact vehicle and version; do not infer falsity solely from differing reserve labels.
decisions.benign_alternative: The author may use a shorthand legal analogy or address a mechanism that is in substance a strategic capacity reserve. A political market-return proposal may also fall outside the target legislative-submission population.

limits: Binary novelty does not establish semantic novelty across redacted, reformatted or joint-author copies. No factual mismatch was established in this selection audit.
